issues.description: Package discovery only includes emovec*, while the default config.yaml is outside the package and will not be available in normal wheel installs.
DEFAULT_CONFIG points to a repository-root config.yaml, making the CLI depend on source-tree layout instead of packaged resources.
Extraction requires pre-generated story files, but the checkout contains no story dataset, so the advertised demo cannot be reproduced cleanly.
generate-stories tries to load data/stories/manifest.json before generating stories, so it cannot bootstrap a missing dataset.
load_vectors trusts stale manifest and .npy artifacts without validating model, scale, emotions, layer count, or shapes against the active config.
The checkout contains ignored build/output artifacts under emovec.egg-info/ and outputs/, undermining reproducibility and repo hygiene.
Committed tiny results contradict the claimed preference behavior: correlation_vs_shift_r is negative and a harmful-adjacent activity has the top Elo.
The only story-loader/data-quality test is skipped when the dataset is absent, so CI would miss the broken default demo path.
urllib.request.urlopen is called without a timeout, so story generation can hang indefinitely on a bad endpoint.
Generated stories are saved without validating forbidden emotion leakage, duplicate/empty stories, or minimum quality beyond delimiter count.
pca_components divides by total variance without handling zero-variance inputs, producing NaNs for constant activation matrices.
emotion_vectors does not validate that every emotion label is present, so missing classes silently produce NaN vectors.
mean_activations can divide by zero for one-token inputs because effective_start can equal the sequence length.
Logit-lens token strings are written into a Markdown table without escaping pipes or newlines, so output reports can be corrupted by tokenizer text.
Emotion names from the vector manifest are interpolated into output filenames without sanitization, allowing path-like names to escape the expected file layout.
Config loading performs no schema or range validation, so invalid values fail late inside model/math code with unclear errors.
